{{reconstructed}}
==Proto-Semitic==

===Etymology===
Reconstructed in Militarev & Kogan's ''Semitic Etymological Dictionary'' as {{m|sem-pro|*ki(n)šād-}}. The Modern South Arabian nasal is not found elsewhere. According to Kaufman, Mandaic {{m|myz|kšada}} is rather "a neck ornament" borrowed from Akkadian.

===Noun===
{{sem-noun|m}}

# [[neck]]
# top of the [[shoulder]]

====Inflection====
{{sem-decl-noun}}
